# 804. Unique Morse Code Words

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def uniqueMorseRepresentations(self, words):
        """
        :type words: List[str]
        :rtype: int
        """
        d = dict(zip("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz",
                     [".-","-...","-.-.","-..",".","..-.","--.",
                      "....","..",".---","-.-",".-..","--","-.",
                      "---",".--.","--.-",".-.","...","-",
                      "..-","...-",".--","-..-","-.--","--.."]))
        seen = set([])
        for word in words:
            t = ""
            for c in word:
                t += d[c]
            seen.add(t)
        return len(seen)
```
